description:
Functional specifications / files: extend lib/zaq/channels/delivery/preparation.ex and add Channel-local execution state only as needed. Reuse acquire/3, Materialization and Attachments.validate_group/2 / validate_upload_group/2. Cache successful and failed acquisition once per original index per attempt; preserve fixed group indices and immutable source Records/Plan. Prepare upload batches or direct-send requests through bridge seams; release bytes/prepared payloads once no remaining step needs them. Direct-send abort prepares all candidates before publication; upload mode prepares/acquires groupwise and finishes required uploads before publication.
Tests before implementation: group/batch ordering, shared-index acquisition once, cached denial once, later preparation failure with abort gives no publication, continue keeps usable files or text-only answer, byte drift and exact bounds, cleanup and concurrent-attempt isolation. Property tests for stable indices and no duplicated acquisition. Nil identity never expands access; pass only trusted materialization context.
Branches: direct-send/upload modes, abort/continue, empty/partial usable sets, raw/base64 content, invalid prepared payload, unknown optional limits.
Mocking: real internal materialization/permission path; stub external retrieval/transport only, inject runtime config. Coordinate tasks with messages.
Documentation: Preparation docs, docs/services/channels.md.
Action reuse: extend existing preparation owner; reuse acquisition and group validation rather than parallel helpers or a new Action. Prepared content is transient local state, never Engine history. Consumption by executor only; adapter owns encoding/provider details.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.
title: [zaq-9j8.3] Prepare fixed delivery groups with bounded attachment lifetime
